input_model: Existing 12 SHA-256-sealed tied ToyLoop checkpoints from loop_schedule_kappa_surface_v1
student_states: h_{R/2} of the actual 16 or 32 tied residual visits

split.independent_rng: LCG32 (state=1664525*state+1013904223 mod 2^32), Box-Muller for every normal; seed=(20261115+7919*task_seed+104729*fold) mod 2^32

supervision: Orthonormal span of eight sample cross-covariance columns H_centered^T Y_centered; centered data; fixed positive-order modified Gram-Schmidt
regression: Fit ridge on 8D projected training H with intercept (fit centered H,Y); evaluate MSE on fresh evaluation fold, dividing SSE by 96*8

leakage.estimator: At each of 12 fresh shadow inputs, calculate matrix D=U^T (J_{R/2: R}) (I-UU^T) from analytic chain-rule and projectors, report mean Frobenius(D)/sqrt(8)
leakage.jvp_base: Per heldout x, derive Jacobian along h_{R/2}..h_R
leakage.note: Single-trajectory and finite-sample derivatives are measurements, not uniform fiber defect certificates

gates.utility: Supervised heldout MSE strictly improves over median of eight random projections on >=5/6 final-exposure cells
gates.leakage: Supervised mean leakage no greater than random-control median on >=5/6 final-exposure cells
gates.dependency: Both gates required before proposing stable semantic observation or causal training intervention

priors: The supervised projection may improve target predictability while amplifying leakage. Preserve that negative case.
Selection over target coordinates or train/eval parameters after results is prohibited.
No model training, weight edits, speculative safety claims, or public transfer of private checkpoints.
